Package storage

Class DataStore

java.lang.Object
storage.DataStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DataStore extends Object implements Serializable
Singleton in-memory data store for the entire UniversitySystem. Acts as the system's "database" — all controllers read and write through this class. Pattern: Singleton (thread-safe via synchronized getInstance()).
